purpose: classify CNINFO keyword hits before any PDF content is inspected
st_title_include_regex: 风险警示|特别处理|暂停上市|终止上市|退市整理|恢复上市|摘帽

st_direction.reversal_regex: 撤销|申请撤销|恢复上市|摘帽
st_direction.onset_regex: 实施|实行|继续实行|暂停上市|终止上市|退市整理

promotion_rules: keyword or title match is candidate-only
company, subsidiary, shareholder, director and controller subjects must be distinguished from PDF text
an investigation is not fraud unless the original document identifies the company and the frozen hard-veto condition
an administrative penalty is not automatically a hard veto until subject, cause and effective date are extracted
a non-standard audit candidate must extract opinion type and covered reporting period
ST onset and reversal are separate events
alpha evidence must extract amount, counterparty, term, cancellation and actual execution status
cancelled announcements cannot be positive evidence
no candidate is written as verified without original PDF hash, page locator and reviewer status
storage_policy: download one PDF to temporary storage, hash and extract text, then delete PDF immediately
